target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
Both disclosures report on 'Net interest income'. The 2023 disclosure (D053) reports $6.35 billion, a 17% decrease. The 2024 disclosure (D050) reports $8.06 billion, a 27% increase. Both provide context on the drivers (interest rates, balances) for the change in this specific line item.

The 2023 disclosure (D053) discusses the offsetting effect of interest expense on net interest income. The 2024 disclosure (D051) specifically details the increase in interest expense components (collateralized financings, deposits, other liabilities) that offset the income increase. These are complementary parts of the same Net Interest Income discussion, but D051 focuses specifically on the expense side explanation which is a distinct aspect of the 2024 narrative compared to the summary in D053. However, looking at the structure, D050 covers the high-level NII change, and D051 covers the expense component detail. D053 covers both the NII figure and the expense driver context. Since D050 is the primary counterpart for the NII figure, D053's detailed expense context aligns with D051's detailed expense context. Thus, D053 can be matched to D050 (figure) and D051 (expense driver detail).
